events.text: Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring is first danced in Paris
Handel's Messiah is first performed in Dublin
West Side Story opens on Broadway
Beethoven's Ninth Symphony is first performed in Vienna

reveal.explanation: Handel's Messiah was first heard in Dublin in 1742, and Beethoven's Ninth Symphony reached a Vienna audience in 1824. The Rite of Spring startled Paris in 1913, and West Side Story opened on Broadway forty-four years later in 1957.

sources.excerpt: It was first performed in Dublin on 13 April 1742 and received its London premiere a year later.
It was first performed in Vienna on 7 May 1824.
When first performed at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées on 29 May 1913, the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography caused a sensation.

After tryouts at the National Theatre in Washington, D.C. and at the Erlanger Theatre in Philadelphia beginning in August 1957, the original Broadway production opened at the Winter Garden Theatre on September 26, to positive reviews.
